bio.Prep/Club: Attended Osaka Gakugei High School in Osaka, Japan … competed with Cerezo Osaka Yanmar Ladies in the WE League, Japan’s top professional league, during the 2024-25 season … also competed with Cerezo Osaka Yanmar Ladies in the Plenus Nadeshiko League Division I from 2022-23 … participated in the Plenus Challenge League with Cerezo Osaka Yanmar Girls from 2019-20 … played for Cerezo Osaka Yanmar Girls U-18 from 2021-24 … helped lead the U-18 squad to the U-18 Winter Girls National Championship and U-18 Summer Girls National Championship titles in 2022 … won the U-18 Winter Girls National Championship again in 2024 … helped the team finish as runner-up at the U-18 Summer Girls National Championship in 2023 … played for Cerezo Osaka Yanmar Girls U-15 from 2018-21 … helped lead the U-15 squad to the U-15 Girls National Championship in 2018, a runner-up finish in 2019 and a quarterfinal appearance in 2020.
bio.Personal: Daughter of Shinichi and Kanae Marui … born in Osaka, Japan … has two brothers, Kazuki and Daiki … her father, Shinichi, played soccer at Sophia University, while her mother, Kanae, played volleyball at Mukogawa Women’s University … her brother, Kazuki, played soccer at Osaka Metropolitan University, and her brother, Daiki, played soccer at Kindai University … participated in Japanese calligraphy throughout high school.

bio.2025 -- Junior: A member of the NCAA College Cup squad that collected a 17-5-1 ledger on the season ... came off the bench and played 60 minutes in a 9-0 victory over VMI on Sept. 4 ... collected her first collegiate assist in the victory ... named to ACC Honor Roll.
bio.2024 -- Sophomore: Appeared in five matches on defense for the Blue Devils ... helped Duke to shutouts in four of those five contests ... saw action in a career-high 28 minutes against Missouri and 26 minutes versus ETSU ... helped lead Duke to just the fourth ACC Regular Season title in program history and an appearance in the NCAA College Cup ... ACC Honor Roll selection.
bio.2023 -- Freshman: Did not see action as a rookie ... named to ACC Honor Roll.
bio.Prep/Club: 2022-23 United Soccer Coaches High School Girls Scholar All-American ... selected to play in the 2022 High School All-American Game … has played for Bethesda Soccer Club ECNL for 13 consecutive seasons … 2021 and 2022 Washington Post First-Team All-Met, All-State and All-Conference … captained and anchored backline for Georgetown Visitation that notched 20+ shutouts in three seasons … led Georgetown Visitation to 2022 ISL Regular Season Championship and 2021 ISL Tournament Championship (first title since 2009) … member of 2019 USYS ODP East Region Team and International Team Selection … 2018 Maryland State Cup Champion … 2018 US Club/Nike Soccer id2 National Camp and USYNT Training/ID Center Selection Attendee.
bio.Personal: Full name is Kaeden Koons-Perdikis … daughter of Alex Perdikis and Dresden Koons … has three sisters, Kosette, Eleanor and Everly … her sister, Kosette, is a freshman on the 2025 Duke women's soccer roster ... her father, Alex, played football at Richmond (1993-96) … her mother, Dresden, is a 1997 Duke graduate and has coached basketball at the high school and AAU level … ranked No. 1 academically in the class at Georgetown Visitation with a 4.62 GPA and a National Merit Scholar … 2021 Leukemia and Lymphoma Society Student of the Year DC Champion/National Runner-up … class Vice-President as a junior and school Vice-President as a senior … 2023 Bethesda Magazine Extraordinary Teen of the Year Award ... earned Dean's List with Distinction in the Fall of 2024, Spring of 2025, Fall of 2025 and Spring of 2026 at Duke ... majoring in psychology. Last updated 8/9/26

bio.2025 -- Junior: Appeared in eight matches on the season and earned her first collegiate start against VMI ... attempted a career-high three shots in the match against VMI ... saw action in 191 minutes ... a part of Duke's NCAA College Cup squad that collected a 17-5-1 ledger ... an ACC Honor Roll recipient.
bio.2024 -- Sophomore: Saw action in seven contests during the season ... attempted shots against ETSU, Missouri and Howard ... appeared in her first two NCAA Tournament contests against Howard and Texas Tech ... helped lead Duke to the ACC Regular Season title and an appearance in the NCAA College Cup ... ACC Honor Roll selection.
bio.2023 -- Freshman: Redshirted the season as a rookie ... named to the ACC Honor Roll.
bio.Prep/Club: Ranked No. 189 in the Class of 2023 by TopDrawerSoccer … listed No. 31 in the Southern California regional rankings … in the TopDrawerSoccer position rankings, was No. 62 among forwards nationally … attended Viewpoint High School where she was named First Team All-State as a junior and senior … earned Division 4 All CIF-SS team honors as a senior in 2023 … was a First Team All-League and Most Valuable Player as a sophomore, junior and senior … led the league in scoring as a sophomore, junior and senior combining to score 66 goals over her high school career … tallied 39 goals and four assists as a senior … helped lead her squad to a 16-4-2 overall and 8-0 mark in the Gold Coast League, including the league title (first since 2018) … as a junior, notched 21 goals and six assists … tallied six goals and one assist as a sophomore in a COVID shortened season … led LAFC SoCal team in both goals and assists for four seasons … top-10 leading scorer nationally for Development Academy in 2019-20 … collected 13 goals and five assists in 2020-21 … tallied nine goals and three assists for Development Academy during the COVID shortened season in 2019-20 … in 2018-19, posted 14 goals and five assists.
bio.Personal: Full name is Madison Foxhoven … daughter of Brad and Kenya Foxhoven … has one brother, Brayden, and two sisters, Kaylee and Jordan … her cousin, Danielle Lauren Foxhoven, played soccer at Portland and went on to play professionally for Seattle Reign FC, Portland Thorns FC and FC Energy Voronezh … Danielle Lauren Foxhoven was also the head coach at Purdue Northwest in 2016 … reached a Level 9 Certificate of Merit in piano ... majoring in sociology. Last updated 8/9/26

bio.Summer of 2026: Played for the San Francisco Glens of the WPSL and earned Honorable Mention Best XI honors.
bio.2025 -- Junior: A member of a NCAA College Cup squad for the second year in a row, while collecting a 17-5-1 ledger ... made her first collegiate start in the season opener against 11th-ranked Penn State ... appeared in two matches on the season in goal ... an ACC Honor Roll selection.
bio.2024 -- Sophomore: Appeared in four matches in goal on the year ... did not allow a goal over 35 minutes ... saw action in her first NCAA Tournament contest against Howard and faced one shot ... helped lead Duke to the ACC Regular Season title with a 9-0-1 ledger and an appearance in the NCAA College Cup ... named to ACC Honor Roll.
bio.2023 -- Freshman: Injured for most of the season and did not see action as a rookie ... ACC Honor Roll selection.
bio.Prep/Club: Played for the San Francisco Glens in the USL-W League in the summer of 2023, 2024 and 2025 … played for the Bay Area Surf ECNL in Northern California … also played for the Girls Academy League (2020-22) and prior to that competed for the Development Academy (2018-20) in Northern California … played ODP and PDP for Cal North prior to joining the Development Academy … participated in three U.S. Youth National Team Identification camps from 2019-21 … in the summer of 2022, played for the Bay Area Surf and received WPSL All-PAC North Conference accolades.
bio.Personal: Full name is Bianca Dominguez … daughter of Daniel Dominguez and Magdalena Perez … has one sister, Amanda … selected to Hercules HS Academic Honor Roll each of her four years ... double-majoring in political science and sociology. Last updated 8/15/26

bio.2025 -- Freshman: As a rookie, appeared in two matches ... played a season-high 69 minutes in a 9-0 victory over VMI ... a member of the NCAA College Cup squad that collected a 17-5-1 ledger ... named to ACC Honor Roll.
bio.Prep/Club: Ranked No. 82 overall in the 2025 Class by TopDrawerSoccer … listed as the No. 5 player from the Northern California and Hawaii regions … helped lead Bay Area Surf to ECNL Nationals Round of 16 in 2023 and 2024 … a NorCal All-League First Team (2023, 2025) and Second Team (2024, 2022) selection … member of the NorCal Player Development Program and advanced to the Gothia Cup finals in 2023 and 2024 … led Mountain View Los Altos to the ECNL National quarterfinals in 2022 … as a freshman and sophomore at Carlmont H.S., notched 32 goals and nine assists … as a sophomore, notched 16 goals and three assists, while starting all matches … led the PAL in scoring … notched 16 goals and six assists as a freshman … earned Carlmont offensive MVP in both seasons, while also being tabbed Freshman of the Year as a rookie … a CIF Central Coast Section All-District Second Team as a freshman and PAL All-District First Team as a sophomore … competed for Bay Area Surf club team.
bio.Personal: Daughter of Yong-Jae Kim and Minjung Park … born in Burlingame, Calif. … has one sister, Emily … graduated from Carlmont H.S., with a 4.0 grade-point average. Last Updated 8/9/2026

bio.2025 -- Sophomore: Appeared in all 23 matches, while starting the final 22 contests in goal for the Blue Devils ... helped lead Duke to the NCAA College Cup and only allowed one goal in five matches during the NCAA Tournament ... allowed only three goals over her final seven contests on the season ... registered a career-high seven saves against Notre Dame and Virginia Tech ... in the ACC, ranked tied for first with 11 shutouts and fifth with a 0.92 goals-against average ... led the league with a .478 shutouts per game average ... her 11 shutouts ranked tied for fifth nationally ... led the NCAA Tournament field with four shutouts ... tallied her first collegiate assist on the road at Virginia Tech ... appeared in 1,956 minutes in goal, which ranked ninth on Duke's single-season charts ... didn't allow a goal for her first 510:19 as a Blue Devil, which was a new Duke record ... the previous longest streak to open a Duke career was Meghan Thomas from 2011-13 (250:39) ... her 11 shutouts on the year ranked tied for third on Duke's single-season record charts ... an ACC Honor Roll selection.
bio.2024 -- Freshman: As a rookie, appeared in five matches in goal ... faced a total of six shots and made two saves over 85:21 minutes ... saw action in her first NCAA Tournament contest against Howard ... helped lead Duke to the ACC Regular Season title with a 9-0-1 ledger and an appearance in the NCAA College Cup ... named to ACC Honor roll.
bio.U.S. Soccer: Member of U.S. Youth National Team pool since 2019 … attended the U.S. Soccer U-16 YNT Domestic Camp in Portland, Ore. … competed in the USYNT West Region 4-day Mini-Camp in Chula Vista, Calif.
bio.Prep/Club: Ranked No. 103 in the class of 2024 by TopDrawerSoccer … the fifth-best goalkeeper in the 2024 class by TopDrawerSoccer … goalkeeper for San Diego Surf DA for 10 years … played in the WPSL So Cal Conference in the summer of 2023, 2024 and 2025 for San Diego Surf … 2022 ECNL Southwest Conference First Team selection … finalist at the 2021 ECNL National Championship … started all four years on the basketball team at Canyon Crest Academy … Second Team All-League in basketball as a sophomore.
bio.Personal: Full name is Caroline Dysart … daughter of Elisabeth Dysart … has three brothers – Andrew, James and Matthew … in high school, was an AP Scholar as a sophomore and AP Scholar with Distinction as a junior ... earned Dean's List with Distinction in the Spring of 2026 at Duke ... majoring in economics. Last Updated 8/15/26
